workspace_tests.note: All crates green; 9 runner service tests, scheduler tests, queue tests, process supervision tests, docker sandbox stub tests

cargo_vet.note: cargo-vet not installed on this system

sandbox_fail_closed.detail: services/runner/src/main.rs:17 sets GITFORGE_SANDBOX_MODE=required before any async runtime init

scheduler_no_auth.detail: No Authorization header check on any scheduler HTTP route (register_runner, heartbeat, get_pending_jobs, assign_job, complete_job)

poll_build_stub.detail: poll-build job contains only echo steps; no actual GET polling call exists in workflow

health_endpoint_insufficient.detail: GET /health on ci service (port 42781) returns 'OK' with no logic. Does not confirm DB connection, queue processing, runner heartbeats, Docker availability, or event bus subscribers.

template_target_committed.result: 3386 deleted files in working tree from template-parts/rust/target/ (compiled artifacts committed to repo)

ci.note: Scheduler embedded in same process; scheduler loop ticks every 5 seconds

critical.title: poll-build job is a stub — no actual job status polling
critical.detail: The poll-build job in gitforge-ci.yml contains only echo steps. There is no GET /api/jobs/{id}/status call, no until loop, no terminal state detection. GitHub Actions cannot determine if the enqueued build passed or failed.

critical.title: Runner receives placeholder job commands, not real pipeline steps
critical.detail: crates/gitforge-scheduler/src/server.rs:135 hardcodes commands: vec!["echo 'job assigned'"] in get_pending_jobs. Real pipeline step definitions from the DB are never transmitted to the runner.

critical.title: Runner uses hardcoded Docker image, ignores job config
critical.detail: RunnerAgent::execute_job hardcodes image: "rust:latest". The actual job's configured image is never used.

critical.title: No runner heartbeat timeout or offline eviction
critical.detail: Scheduler stores runner last_heartbeat in-memory only. There is no timeout threshold, no background task to mark runners offline, and no call to process_queue to reassign orphaned jobs after runner crash.

critical.title: assigned jobs survive runner crashes permanently
critical.detail: Jobs in 'assigned' status in DB after runner crash are never re-enqueued. No recovery mechanism exists on scheduler startup or as a background task.

high.title: Scheduler HTTP API has no authentication
high.detail: All routes (register_runner, heartbeat, get_pending_jobs, assign_job, complete_job) are unauthenticated. Any client that can reach port 42781 can register fake runners and manipulate job state.

high.title: GitHub webhook trigger token is a placeholder
high.detail: gitforge-ci.yml:37 uses 'Bearer $GITFO...OKEN' (redacted). The actual token is not confirmed to be in GitHub Secrets.

high.title: InMemoryEventBus provides no event durability
high.detail: Events are lost on CI process restart. Control-plane triggers persist the PipelineRun before publishing (correct), but native push events from git-server lack a durable backing store.

high.title: SQLite concurrent writer contention between api and ci services
high.detail: Both api and ci services open sqlite:/data/gitforge.db over Docker volume. A stuck writer in ci service will block api service queries. No lock timeout configured.

high.title: template-parts/rust/target/ committed to repository
high.detail: 3386 compiled artifact files (hundreds of MB) are tracked in git under template-parts/rust/target/. Not in .gitignore. Inflates clones, pollutes diffs.

high.title: workspaces/ directory is untracked and unignored
high.detail: workspaces/platform-aegis-gitforge-smoke-20260825/ is present as an untracked directory.

medium.title: Release artifacts have no provenance attestation
medium.detail: No per-binary signing, no SBOM, no reproducibility check. Only SHA256SUMS of the tar.gz archives.

medium.title: Clippy strict mode (-D warnings) fails on gitforge-api
medium.detail: 3 unnecessary_lazy_evaluations errors prevent strict clippy from passing. Developers running 'make lint' (which calls clippy) will see failures.

medium.title: No schema migration system
medium.detail: Pool::migrate() exists but migration definitions are unversioned. Schema upgrades require manual intervention.

medium.title: No rate limiting on POST /pipelines/trigger
medium.detail: An authorized client can trigger unlimited pipeline runs without throttling.

medium.title: Stale comment in release.yml
medium.detail: Line 15 reads 'cross-compilation not available' but cross-compilation is actively used for macOS and Windows targets in the same file.

implementation_steps.action: Implement actual job status polling in poll-build job: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/status with until loop polling until terminal state (success/failed/cancelled), exit 0 on success, exit 1 on failure
Wire real pipeline step commands from DB to runner job assignment: replace placeholder in get_pending_jobs with actual step data queried from PipelineQueries and JobQueries
Add runner heartbeat timeout and auto-offline eviction: background task checks last_heartbeat, marks runners offline after threshold (e.g., 90s), calls process_queue to reassign orphaned jobs
Add assigned job recovery on scheduler startup: query jobs in 'assigned' status, verify runner is still online via heartbeat, move stale assignments back to 'queued'
Add Bearer token authentication to all scheduler HTTP routes: X-Schcheduler-Token header checked against GITFORGE_SCHEDULER_TOKEN env var
Add GITFORGE_CI_TRIGGER_TOKEN to GitHub Secrets; update gitforge-ci.yml to use secrets.GITFORGE_CI_TRIGGER_TOKEN in Authorization header
Configure SQLite busy_timeout or migrate to PostgreSQL for concurrent writer access; add health check to docker-compose for api service
Fix Clippy strict lints in gitforge-api/src/routes/ci.rs: replace ok_or_else(|| '...') with ok_or('...') on lines 604, 608, 612
Upgrade runner heartbeat/fetch failure logs from trace to warn or error level to enable alerting
Add docker healthcheck to runner service in docker-compose: check Docker ping and sandbox connectivity
Remove template-parts/rust/target/ from git tracking, add to .gitignore, delete from history with BFG or git filter-branch
Implement sqlx migration files for schema versioning
Add per-binary SHA256 to release artifacts; consider separate sig files per binary
Replace InMemoryEventBus with gitforge-db-backed durable event log for git-server push events
Add rate limiting to POST /pipelines/trigger using in-memory token bucket or Redis
